evidence.title: GitHub - salimi-my/shadcn-ui-sidebar: A stunning, functional and responsive retractable sidebar for Next.js built on top of shadcn/ui. · GitHub

name: shadcn/ui sidebar
summary: Retractable Next.js sidebar for shadcn/ui with mini and wide states, collapsible submenus and a mobile sheet menu.
description: A retractable app sidebar component for Next.js built on shadcn/ui, responsive on desktop and mobile. It switches between mini and wide states, scrolls its menu, groups items under labels and collapses submenus, with menu items kept in an extracted list and a sheet menu on mobile. State is managed with Zustand; installs from a custom shadcn registry or by copying the components. Demo at shadcn-ui-sidebar.salimi.my. MIT licensed.
contains: retractable sidebar with mini and wide states
scrollable menu with grouped items and labels; collapsible submenu
sheet menu for mobile; extracted menu items list
stack: Next.js 14, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Zustand
installs from a custom shadcn registry or by copy-paste
